jobOpening.jobOpeningName: Night time Localization & Interpreting Project Manager
jobOpening.description:
Night Shift Project Manager — Localization, Translation, Interpreting & Sales

Company: Day Translations, Inc.
Position type: Full-time
Location: Remote — worldwide
Schedule: U.S. nighttime hours. Exact hours and applicable U.S. time zone will be confirmed during hiring.

Day Translations is a global translation and interpreting company. We help individuals, organizations, and businesses communicate worldwide through accurate translations, localization, interpreting, and tailored language solutions.

We are seeking a full-time Project Manager with strong sales experience and knowledge of localization, translation, and interpreting to join our night team.

This position combines project management, client service, and sales. You will manage language projects from inquiry through delivery, convert inquiries into paying clients, close deals with large interpreting clients, and help businesses sign up for phone interpreting services through Day Interpreting.

The ideal candidate can confidently lead client conversations, explain our services, negotiate effectively, and close business while keeping projects organized and on schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Manage localization, translation, and interpreting projects from initial inquiry and quoting through scheduling, delivery, and completion.
  • Lead sales conversations with prospective clients, understand their needs, recommend appropriate services, and close deals.
  • Pursue and close large interpreting opportunities, including ongoing service agreements with businesses and organizations.
  • Guide clients through signing up for Day Inte
